title: A Culture of Grit
coreMove: Join or build a group where the normal answer to difficulty is sustained effort.
sourcePressure: Show how groups make grit easier by turning standards into identity and language.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating grit as only an individual trait and ignoring peer norms.

sourceAnchors.name: Pete Carroll
sourceAnchors.detail: The Seattle Seahawks coach contacted Duckworth about building a culture of grit and used shared language around competition and finishing strong.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Carroll’s culture turns effort into a team dialect, so a player hears the standard before he has to choose.

sourceAnchors.name: Finland and sisu
sourceAnchors.detail: Duckworth uses Finnish sisu and the 1939 Winter War as an example of perseverance becoming part of national identity.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Sisu shows what happens when perseverance stops being a private mood and becomes a word everyone knows.
